state_rules.same_root: A recurrence with the same root issue reopens the existing ID; a different root creates a linked new issue.
state_rules.regression: A regression is a new immutable issue linked by regression_of.
state_rules.terminal: Only Project Owner authority may set DEFERRED, ACCEPTED_RISK, or WONT_FIX; terminal records cannot be deleted.
state_rules.repair_scope: A repair claim names exactly one compliant READY root and a bounded causal closure. Every companion is typed SEAM_FINDING or SCOPE_AMENDMENT and links by CHILD_OF, DEPENDS_ON, SAME_ROOT_CAUSE, or OWNER_ATOMIC_SEAM.
state_rules.scope_amendment: Each material companion has a stable registered ID, explicit Owner authority, rationale, bounded path list, and verification mapping; self-authorization and unrelated scope fail closed.
state_rules.projection: Transitions to delivered/resolved state require the dual issues.md/cleared-issues.md projection reconciliation and immutable delivery evidence.
